statement: Under the actual transitive-source hypotheses of C81, restriction identifies the original closed-disk relative centralizer exactly with interior Q-equivariant homeomorphisms whose d_Q displacement descends to C_0(O/Q). Identity extension is the explicit inverse, and the uniform map-and-inverse metrics are equal. For compact metric parameter spaces, joint interior continuity and uniform vanishing quotient displacement are exactly the original joint boundary and inverse-continuity requirements. No uniform-continuity hypothesis is added to the interior image; it follows from the proved extension.
depends_on: C81 actual invariant metric, specified quotient covering, transitive-source compact-core comparison and topology; continuous displacement and exact inverse/composition formulas, compact-family tail criterion and closed-disk extension maps proved here
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), exact actual-boundary image and compact-parameter criterion for the remaining discrete-operator cutoff.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The boundary proof separately treats quotient-escaping sequences and sequences with a common compact quotient core. In the second case it uses compact families of actual boundary-fixed source maps, retaining the original operators without assuming that they extend to the circle. The continuous inverse family follows from the displayed compact product homeomorphism.
computational_checks: This is a topological comparison without a new finite or numerical counterexample. The exact displacement identities and maps are proved in the text; structural checks validate the JSON, unique equation labels and literal TeX control sequences.
source_verification: No new external source is imported. All external inputs are the previously verified and fully stated C81 metric and compact-core comparisons; their exact maps are recalled in the proof.
notes: The general C12 cutoff remains open. The result states the exact required uniform C_0 condition for a proposed equivariant deformation and does not infer such a deformation from compact-open convergence on the quotient, a Whitney deformation, or finite-configuration comparisons. Accepted C84-C87 and all earlier fragments remain unchanged.
